concepts.title: ACTIVATION PROCEDURE
concepts.description: Outlines prerequisites, traffic impact, recommended rollout order, and CLI commands for activating Closed-Loop Power Control High-Band.

concepts.title: DEACTIVATION PROCEDURE
concepts.description: Step-by-step procedure and traffic impact details for deactivating the Closed-Loop Power Control High-Band feature.

concepts.title: Feature Dependencies
concepts.description: Details the feature, hardware, and network dependencies, as well as operational limitations, for deploying Closed-Loop Power Control High-Band.

concepts.title: FEATURE OPERATION
concepts.description: Details the operation of Closed-Loop Power Control High-Band including per-carrier state tracking, TPC commands, and blockage recovery.

concepts.title: FEATURE OVERVIEW
concepts.description: Provides an overview of Closed-Loop Power Control High-Band for NR FR2/mmWave carriers operating as PCells or SCells in carrier aggregation.

concepts.title: NETWORK IMPACT
concepts.description: Overview of network impacts including uplink interference, throughput, UE battery life, signaling load, and KPIs for Closed-Loop Power Control High-Band.

concepts.title: PARAMETERS
concepts.description: Configurable parameters for Closed-Loop Power Control High-Band set per NR sector carrier.

concepts.title: PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT
concepts.description: Performance management metrics, KPIs, and counters for assessing closed-loop power control in FR2 high-band cells.
